Problem Statement:
You are given a task to tell whether the number is pure or not. A pure number is a number whose sum of digits is multiple of 3. O(1) time and O(1) space 
Input Description:
You are given a number n. 
Output Description:
Print yes if it is pure else not 
Explanation:
1+3=4 which is not multiple of 3 
Sample Input:
13 
Sample Output:
not
